evals.prompt: What percentage of our youth are currently in education (school or college)? Break it down by region.
evals.expected_output: Uses CONSO CAT roll-up (~13,058 of 20,943 = 62.4%), region table, states denominator, notes pending/unknown share.

evals.prompt: for the 19-25 age group in Hyderabad local board, how many are in college and what streams are they in? how many are in emerging careers?
evals.expected_output: Filter Current_Local_Board=Hyderabad & age 19-25, count #ACCESSING TERTIARY, stream breakdown, emerging vs non-emerging.

evals.prompt: What are the top reasons kids aged 6-18 are not studying? I need this for our board meeting next week.
evals.expected_output: Confirmed not-studying = CONSO CAT #NOT STUDYING (234 aged 6-18); reasons ranked only within that group; untraceable (181) and migrated (339) shown as separate lines; board-ready summary.

evals.expected_output: Uses school quality groups (Good A/B, Mediocre C/D, Aga Khan AK/AKP); LIG 24.7% good vs 53.2% non-LIG; 65.3% vs 40.0% mediocre; region breakdown.
